summary.text: Charles H. Clements is a Republican member of the West Virginia Senate from District 2, listed with Wetzel County; the district covers Wetzel, Tyler and Doddridge counties and parts of Marshall, Marion and Monongalia. His legislative page lists him as vice chair of the Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Clements holds an A.B. in mathematics from West Virginia University and lists his occupation as retired.
His page gives his birthplace as Huntington, West Virginia, names his spouse as Eugenia, and lists two children, Paul S. Clements and Judith Charlene Murphy.
It lists his affiliations as Rotary and football official.
Clements also serves on the Senate's Economic Development, Finance, Military, Pensions and Transportation and Infrastructure committees and on the Select Committee on School Choice.
